name: ai-streaming-text
title: AI Streaming Text
description: Response streaming container with ambient blinking cursor, interactive inline citation chips with hover source popovers, and follow-up suggestion pills.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Renders ambient pulsing streaming cursor at end of text

props.name: sources
props.description: Array of citations with domain, title, snippet, and confidence score

props.name: onFollowUpClick
props.description: Callback when user clicks a follow-up prompt pill

examples.title: Streamed Answer with Citations
examples.description: AI response with inline source badges and follow-up prompt chips.
examples.code:
<AiStreamingText
  content="Catmull-Rom cubic splines pass directly through control points, avoiding overshoot."
  sources={sources}
  followUps={['Benchmark performance', 'Export TypeScript']}
/>
